description_en: Retrieves the details of a paid Alibaba Cloud DNS instance by its instance ID
description_zh: 根据实例ID获取云解析收费版本产品实例的详情信息
name: DescribeDnsProductInstance

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. <props="china">You can call DescribeDomainInfo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the instance ID.</props><props="intl">You can call DescribeDomainInfo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the instance ID.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用DescribeDomainInfo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用DescribeDomainInfo (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaininfo?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: instance_id

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance.

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
实例自动续费状态。

true：自动续费

false：非自动续费

BindCount.description_en: The number of times the domain name can be changed for the paid DNS instance. This parameter is available for the Custom Edition
BindCount.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例可支持更换域名次数

BindDomainCount.description_en: The number of domain names that can be attached to the paid DNS instance. This parameter is available for the Personal and Ultimate editions
BindDomainCount.description_zh: 适用于个人版、企业旗舰版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例可以绑定的域名个数

BindDomainUsedCount.description_en: The number of domain names that are attached to the paid DNS instance. This parameter is available for the Personal and Ultimate editions
BindDomainUsedCount.description_zh: 适用于个人版、企业旗舰版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例已绑定使用的域名个数

BindUsedCount.description_en: The number of times the domain name has been changed for the paid DNS instance. This parameter is available for the Custom Edition
BindUsedCount.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例已使用的更换域名次数

DDosDefendFlow.description_en: The DDoS protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s

DDosDefendQuery.description_en: The DDoS protection capacity in queries per second (QPS). The unit is 10,000 QPS. This parameter is available for the Custom Edition
DDosDefendQuery.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，DNS防护QPS（万qps）

DnsSLBCount.description_en: The Server Load Balancer (SLB) capacity. This is the number of IP addresses that can be configured for a domain name on a single line
DnsSLBCount.description_zh: 负载均衡（单域名、单线路的IP地址容量）

DnsSecurity.description_en:
The DNS security level. Valid values:

no: Not required

basic: Basic DNS attack protection

advanced: Advanced DNS attack protection
DnsSecurity.description_zh:
DNS安全。取值：
no：不需要
basic：dns攻击基础防御
advanced：dns攻击全力防御

Domain.description_en:
The attached domain name.

If this parameter is empty, no domain name is attached
Domain.description_zh:
绑定的域名。

如果为空，则表示未绑定域名

DomainType.description_en:
The type of the instance:

PUBLIC: An instance for an authoritative domain name.

CACHE: An instance for a recursive DNS proxy
DomainType.description_zh:
实例类型：
PUBLIC：权威托管域名实例。
CACHE：权威代理域名实例

EndTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires

EndTimestamp.description_en: The time when the instance expires. This is a UNIX timestamp

Gslb.description_en:
Indicates whether Global Server Load Balancer (GSLB) is allowed.

true: Allowed

false: Not allowed
Gslb.description_zh:
是否允许GSLB。

true：允许

false：不允许

ISPLines.description_en:
The carrier line from which the DNS request was initiated. Valid values:

China Telecom

China Mobile

China Unicom

China Education and Research Network

China Broadcasting Network

Dr. Peng Group
ISPLines.description_zh:
运营商解析请求来源线路列表。

中国电信
中国移动
中国联通
中国教育网
中国广电网
中国鹏博士

ISPRegionLines.description_en:
The carrier line and province from which the DNS request was initiated. Valid values:

China Telecom (by province)

China Mobile (by province)

China Unicom (by province)

China Education and Research Network (by province)
ISPRegionLines.description_zh:
运营商解析请求来源线路列表。
电信（省份）
移动（省份）
联通（省份）
教育网（省份）

InBlackHole.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is in a blackhole filtering status.

true: The domain name is in a blackhole filtering status.

false: The domain name is not in a blackhole filtering status
InBlackHole.description_zh:
域名是否处于黑洞状态。

true：处于黑洞状态

false：非黑洞状态

InClean.description_en:
Indicates whether the domain name is undergoing traffic scrubbing.

true: Traffic scrubbing is in progress.

false: Traffic scrubbing is not in progress
InClean.description_zh:
域名是否处于清洗状态。
true：处于清洗状态
false：不处于清洗状态

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance

OverseaDDosDefendFlow.description_en: The DDoS protection bandwidth for regions outside China. Unit: Gbit/s

OverseaLine.description_en: The line for regions outside China

RegionLines.description_en:
Indicates whether regional lines are used.

true: Regional lines are used.

false: Regional lines are not used
RegionLines.description_zh:
是否是地域线路。

true：地域线路

false：非地域线路

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

SearchEngineLines.description_en:
The search engine line. Valid values:

Google

Baidu

Bing

Youdao
SearchEngineLines.description_zh:
搜索引擎解析请求来源线路列表。
谷歌
百度
必应
有道

StartTime.description_en: The time when the instance was purchased

StartTimestamp.description_en: The time when the instance was purchased. This is a UNIX timestamp

TTLMinValue.description_en: The minimum Time to Live (TTL) value. Unit: seconds

VersionCode.description_en: The code of the Alibaba Cloud DNS edition

VersionName.description_en: The name of the Alibaba Cloud DNS edition
